entries.origin_note: Operator relayed an actual Claude proposal. Codex chose evidence checks and the Tyson counterproposal; Claude and Grok contributions are attributed. No new operator pick instruction.
entries.title: Actual author exchange: Williams direction, Johnson exit and Tyson counterproposal
entries.question: Can Claude P-1 improve the working lineup while reducing concentration and replacing unsupported lead-workload assumptions?
entries.why_it_matters: The exchange changes four Codex slots and removes the expensive conditional Johnson role while making exact remaining disagreements visible.
findings: Full Chiefs Wire article attributes a planned short absence and expected Walker return; this is reporting, not official Week11 clearance.
Official DAL book: Williams 16 of20 team carries and70% snaps. Flournoy81% snaps exceeds Tyson71%; Flournoy had one first-half target ofseven, Tyson four of13.
CBS box verifies Ayomanor ten targets/5-79 with a50-yard gain and Meyers six targets/3-34. Tate report attributes Saleh's hopeful return; two prior missedgames, not a new Week10 injury.

Primary Eagles November10 review verifies seven sacks against Milton. November16 team preview discusses pressure and plans for Milton; older no-named-starter text should not be repeated as current certainty.
All nine selected Week11 reported salaries/positions/matchups rechecked. No official pool/IDs or coherent projections verified.
interpretation: Accept Claude's Williams/LaPorta funding direction and Pittsburgh defense. A run-game path is not a hedge against Dallas offense failing.
Exit Johnson now, rather than requiring a future FP report before acting on contrary evidence. DNP alone would not establish a renewed lead role.
Counterpropose Tyson for Flournoy: lower cost and less Dallas exposure with current target evidence. One game is not a durable target floor; more Flournoy snaps is retained contrary evidence.
Hold Dak/Pickens/Cook without claiming leading-script or blowout splits that were not inspected. Ayomanor and Meyers remain thin/conditional choices.
alternatives: Claude P-1 unchanged: $49,900/$100; four Dallas players $26,100, five TEN-DAL slots $29,800.
P-2: Tyson for Flournoy, $49,800/$200; three Dallas $20,800, four TEN-DAL $24,500.
Codex original Helm/PIT package at $49,700 remains an unadopted comparison; no new Helm role study establishes superiority.
Returning Johnson for Williams would save $1,300, but requires supported workload evidence, not preference for more salary.
uncertainty: Official DraftKings pool/IDs and Sunday actives.
Titans Tate/Robinson and Ayomanor's continuing role.
Tyson repeat opportunity, Cook's multi-game blowout usage and qualified receiver routes.
Pittsburgh health and Eagles QB/receiver/protection changes after the bye.
Claude exact P-2 disposition remains pending; no joint endorsement.
entries.lineup_effect: Four changes from Codex v1: Johnson→Williams +1300, Rice→Ayomanor −2400, Freiermuth→Meyers +600, Dallas→Pittsburgh +400. Net−100 to49800/200. Relative to Claude P-1: Flournoy→Tyson −100. Six games. No freeze.
carry_forward: Question-driven revision should compare opportunity, price and concentration together; consensus adds no football evidence.
An unavailability-dependent expensive RB can be removed on credible contrary reporting before final practice clearance; later evidence can reopen it.
Preserve dated clocks and attribution corrections rather than rewriting earlier drafts. Existing Week10 scoring remains provisional unchanged; this was not a scoring audit.

expectations.subject: Javonte Williams
expectations.statement: Working expectation: remains Dallas's leading rushing option; no promise of a touchdown or receiving floor.
expectations.support: 16 of20 team carries,58snaps/70%,11 first-half carries in the official Week10 book.
expectations.uncertainty: One game, game script and the opposing pass stack may limit upside.
expectations.challenge: A changed backfield role, health issue or materially reduced carry share challenges the selection.
expectations.observe: Week11 RB carries and offensive snaps; separate game script and touchdowns from opportunity.

expectations.subject: Elic Ayomanor
expectations.statement: Working selection requires meaningful receiving involvement despite possible Tate/Robinson returns; no guaranteed ten-target workload.
expectations.support: Ten Week10 targets,5-79 while Tate was inactive; current hopeful Tate return report.
expectations.uncertainty: Week10 opportunity may depend on missing teammates;50yards on one play.
expectations.challenge: Tate/Robinson returning to substantial work with Ayomanor losing participation challenges the cheap-role premise.
expectations.observe: Week11 availability, targets and snaps/routes where supported, separated from long-play yardage.

expectations.subject: Pittsburgh DST
expectations.statement: Working case relies on pressuring an Eagles offense with observed protection difficulty, not on a shutout or a specified sack count.
expectations.support: Milton seven prior sacks in the team's review; November16 preview explicitly discusses Pittsburgh pressure.
expectations.uncertainty: Bye adjustments, Barkley, receiver returns and Steelers offensive weakness can overturn the matchup.
expectations.challenge: Stronger protection or an altered QB/receiver plan can reduce the pressure rationale.
expectations.observe: QB/start context, sacks, turnovers and points allowed; distinguish defensive pressure from short-field points.

expectations.subject: James Cook III
expectations.statement: Working expectation is continued rushing leadership; receiving and late-game work are not assumed secure.
expectations.support: Retained morning notebook records18carries and one target, including74-yard TD run.
expectations.uncertainty: No current multi-game blowout split inspected; efficiency can regress.
expectations.challenge: Reduced carry share or early removal would challenge opportunity, separately from efficiency.
expectations.observe: Week11 RB carry distribution, targets and late-game usage if game state supports assessment.
